faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your stay

q1.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
q1.a: Check-in is from 2:00 PM. Check-out must be completed before 12:00 PM. If you need to arrive earlier or leave later, please contact the reception.

q2.q: How can I cancel or modify my booking?
q2.a: You can cancel for free up to 48 hours before your arrival date. For any changes, please contact us by email or phone with your booking number.

q3.a: Yes, we accept small pets (under 10 kg) for an additional fee of 20 CHF per night. Please let us know in advance.

q4.q: Is breakfast included in the price?
q4.a: The buffet breakfast is included for certain rooms and rates. You can check the details during your booking or add the breakfast option at any time.

q5.q: Do you offer an airport shuttle service?
q5.a: Yes, we offer a private shuttle service upon request. Please provide your flight details at least 24 hours before arrival so we can arrange your transfer.

review2.text: Very clean room, excellent bedding. The Wi-Fi works perfectly, which was important for my work. I highly recommend.

review3.author: Amélie T.
review3.text: We spent a family weekend. The kids loved the pool. The airport shuttle service was very convenient. Thank you for the welcome!
